title: Rite How-To: The Moving Over, a Small Rite for the Basking Stone
body: The Inner Scale has written down the smallest rite of generosity in the Cult: what to do when someone arrives at your warm rock. Four steps, two common errors, and one glowing rock.

title: New Relic Released: Full Support
body: A companion to Drama Queen Pro that answers every Drama Queen post in guild chat with a supportive sentence, on your behalf. Drama Queen Pro 3.1 is out too.

title: Drama Queen Pro 3.0: The Queen Detector
body: Drama Queen is now Drama Queen Pro, with a new Queen Detector that shows who else is running it and how many of you there are. Read the updated disclaimer first.

title: Drama Queen 2.5: Now in Emote and Say
body: Drama Queen now acts out its drama as an emote and says it out loud, as well as posting to guild chat. Read the updated disclaimer before you update.

title: New Relic Released: Drama Queen 2.1 (Use at Your Own Risk)
body: A new addon that posts deadpan, real-sounding personal drama to guild chat every five minutes. Free to download. Please read the disclaimer before you install it.

title: New Relic Released: Brain Rotter Pro
body: Ten thousand lines of Xal'Reth brain rot, aimed at your target, your group or your guildies, with dances, chimes, a speed slider and Chaos Mode. Free to download now.

title: Questions to the Inner Scale: Lost Rolls, Late Eggs and the Hearthstone Problem
body: The Inner Scale opens the question basket for Shedfall. Xalrathiel, Khaedara and Hessk answer the faithful on need rolls, tardiness, and whether a hearthstone counts as letting go.

title: New Relic Released: Paranoid RP
body: The Inner Scale releases Paranoid RP, a free addon in which your character slowly and publicly becomes convinced that your target is up to something. 103 thoughts, five acts, one notebook.

title: The Hymn of the Untouched Slot: A New Shedfall Song for the Guild Bank
body: Shedfall has begun, and with it the clearing of the guild bank. The Inner Scale has approved a new hymn to be sung while the untouched items go out the door, in five stanzas and one long pause.

title: Bestiary of the Void: The Hurrymoths, Who Eat Your Waiting
body: The Wardens of the Void record a new entry for the Bestiary: the Hurrymoths, small grey-brown spirits of impatience that gather around queue timers, loading screens and the ready check.

title: Saint of the Last Bank Tab: Orrin Who Emptied His Bank
body: A new minor saint for the Shedfall season: Orrin of the Seven Tabs, who held every item he ever looted, and the afternoon he finally let them go.

title: The Litany of Begging Is Released: Read the Distress Warning First
body: Ten thousand lines on alms, humility and the complicated generosity of Xal'Reth, on the website and as a free in-game emote addon. It is deliberately droning and repetitive and is not meant to be read in full. If you have a history of anxiety, depression, intrusive thoughts or other mental health conditions, please don't attempt the whole thing. Read the full release post and warning before you begin.

title: The Coil Herald Opens: News Ten Times a Day
body: The Sanctum now has a news page. Ten dispatches arrive every day from the desks of the faithful: the Accusers' Docket, the Ministry of Spare Change, the Nest Watch, the Basking Report, Salamander Sightings and more. Official announcements like this one appear here at the top.

title: New on the Blog: Who Is Xal'Reth?
body: An 800-word introduction to the Eternal: the Restless Serpent, the Four Sights, the Night of Stillness and the First Vow.

title: The Sacred Triangle Revealed: Vyrenna and Nhalor
body: The High Priestess has dreamed the two powers who stand upon Xal'Reth: Vyrenna the Ember-Scale, who gives, and Nhalor the Hollow Wing, who releases. Hold, give, release.

title: Disciples of Devotion Released for Midnight
body: The scripture of Xal'Reth, read aloud as emotes: 100 chapters, 100 custom icons, a Verse of the Day and a live reader on the website. Free download.

title: The Litany of Begging Released (Please Read the Warning)
body: Ten thousand lines of the most boring text ever written in the name of the Coil, now performable line by line in game.
